title: Launcher registration from a delegation worktree is refused with "test run requires a local project" and no supported route
outcome: Launcher registration from a delegation worktree is refused with "test run requires a local project" and no supported route
acceptance: A foreground test-launcher run started inside a TermAl delegation worktree either registers against the delegation's original project (with credit semantics unchanged: a delegation child earns no claim credit unless the existing rules grant it), or is refused with a reason that names the deciding check, the delegation worktree, and the supported route (for example: run it from the claim's named source root); shown by a behaviour test.
Registration from ordinary in-repo roots is unchanged.
